repository_differences: scripts/gemma7b_mixpretrain.sh uses Gemma-7B and DCLM/JourneyDB, not the paper Llama3/HOI/LAION mixture.
README pretrained checkpoint identifier remains Path/To/UniHOI_7B.
train/train.py loads AutoModelForCausalLM directly; it does not instantiate ModalityAwareLMWrapper.
Collator emits modality_types, but no released model consumes it in the advertised training path.
No IAA block or dual-cycle training objective found in the released executable model/training code.
HOI detection instructions refer to VQA evaluation; no native V-COCO box-role exporter is supplied.
declared_choices_not_author_verified: Single projected-head implementation of Eq.4/5; paper does not specify head count.
Prefix-only placement supplied as an explicit adapter hypothesis, not claimed original layer placement.
unresolved_required_details: Actual Llama3 checkpoint revision and expanded vocabulary / special-token mapping.
IAA layer placement, head count and structured semantic conditioning at detection inference.
Differentiation through discrete cycle generation; Eq.6 L1 versus Eq.7 sequence cross entropy.
Definitions of attention-map semantic alignment and diversity losses.
Original extra-data sample manifests, filtering and leakage audit.
Bounding-box token serialization, confidence score definition and missing-role handling.

supervised_detection_path.scope: Independent supervised detection path, not full bidirectional/cycle UniHOI
supervised_detection_path.training_scope: Fixed 10-epoch supervised detection adaptation; not full paper recipe
supervised_detection_path.training_protocol: seed42; 10 epochs; global batch32; Adam peak5e-5; 169 warmup updates; cosine decay; V-COCO trainval only
